entries.rail:
// —— ramps ————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
@fragment fn fs_rail(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { return out(rail(pow(field(cell_uv(fp.xy)), mix(0.5, 2.0, u.k.x)))); }
entries.grey_gamma: @fragment fn fs_grey_gamma(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let t = field(cell_uv(fp.xy)); return out(vec3f(pow(t, mix(0.3, 3.0, u.k.x)))); }
entries.hsv_sweep:
// —— spaces ————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
@fragment fn fs_hsv_sweep(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let t = field(cell_uv(fp.xy)); return out(hsv2rgb(t + u.time * 0.03, mix(0.5, 1.0, u.k.x), mix(0.6, 1.0, u.k.y))); }
entries.oklch_sweep:
// the same hue sweep at constant OKLCH lightness and chroma — no dark blue / bright yellow bias
@fragment fn fs_oklch_sweep(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let t = field(cell_uv(fp.xy)); return out(oklch(mix(0.5, 0.85, u.k.y), mix(0.05, 0.2, u.k.x), t * TAU + u.time * 0.2)); }
entries.clip: @fragment fn fs_clip(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { return out(linear_to_srgb(clamp(hdr(cell_uv(fp.xy)), vec3f(0.0), vec3f(1.0)))); }
entries.reinhard: @fragment fn fs_reinhard(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let c = hdr(cell_uv(fp.xy)); return out(linear_to_srgb(c / (1.0 + c))); }
entries.reinhard_ext: @fragment fn fs_reinhard_ext(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let c = hdr(cell_uv(fp.xy)); let w = mix(2.0, 16.0, u.k.y); return out(linear_to_srgb(c * (1.0 + c / (w * w)) / (1.0 + c))); }
entries.aces: @fragment fn fs_aces(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let c = hdr(cell_uv(fp.xy)); let m = (c * (2.51 * c + 0.03)) / (c * (2.43 * c + 0.59) + 0.14); return out(linear_to_srgb(clamp(m, vec3f(0.0), vec3f(1.0)))); }
entries.hable: @fragment fn fs_hable(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let c = hdr(cell_uv(fp.xy)); let W = vec3f(11.2); return out(linear_to_srgb(hable(c * 2.0) / hable(W))); }
entries.posterize:
// —— quantize / dither ——————————————————————————————————————————————————————
@fragment fn fs_posterize(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let t = field(cell_uv(fp.xy)); let n = floor(mix(2.0, 12.0, u.k.x)); return out(rail(floor(t * n + 0.5) / n)); }
entries.ign_dither: @fragment fn fs_ign_dither(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let t = field(cell_uv(fp.xy)); let n = floor(mix(1.0, 5.0, u.k.x)); return out(rail(floor(t * n + ign(floor(fp.xy / mix(1.0, 4.0, u.k.y)))) / n)); }
entries.duotone: @fragment fn fs_duotone(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let t = field(cell_uv(fp.xy)); return out(select(u.ink.rgb, u.cream.rgb, t + (ign(fp.xy) - 0.5) * u.k.y > mix(0.3, 0.7, u.k.x))); }
entries.contours: @fragment fn fs_contours(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let t = field(cell_uv(fp.xy)); let n = mix(4.0, 20.0, u.k.x); let f = fract(t * n); let line = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.12, min(f, 1.0 - f)); return out(mix(rail(floor(t * n) / n), u.cream.rgb, line * u.k.y)); }
entries.cycle:
// —— effects ————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
@fragment fn fs_cycle(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let t = field(cell_uv(fp.xy)); return out(rail(fract(t * mix(1.0, 4.0, u.k.x) - u.time * 0.3))); }
